# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

translational and clinical research][97].

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## Les 15 ans de l'Autorité de la concurrence

L’Autorité fêtait ses 15 ans le 5 novembre 2024, dans le cadre d’un événement placé sous le haut
patronage du Président de la République.

[
[eco]
][81]

## Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN)

Créé en mai 2004, le Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN) fête cette année son 20ème anniversaire.
Entre mai 2004 et décembre 2023, les autorités nationales de concurrence ont rendu plus de 1 700
décisions fondées sur l'article 101 et/ou l'article 102. Les autorités nationales de concurrence ont
lancé en moyenne 140 enquêtes et adopté 75 décisions chaque année.

[
[podcast ]
][82]

## Cartels & Cie

Cartels & Cie est un podcast dédié aux grandes affaires démantelées par l'Autorité, qui se propose
d'emmener l'auditeur dans les coulisses de ses enquêtes, au cœur de scandales économiques impliquant
des entreprises mondiales.

[
[Guide PME]
][83]

## Espace PME

Dans une démarche de pédagogie, l’Autorité a créé un espace en ligne, intégralement dédié aux PME.
Un guide est mis à leur disposition afin qu'elles connaissent mieux les règles et puissent faire
valoir leurs droits.

## Contact

Des questions sur vos démarches, des procédures en cours... Contactez-nous !

## Professions réglementées

[Accéder][77]

## Consultations publiques et tests de marché en cours

Dans le cadre de l'instruction des dossiers ou l'élaboration de documents, l'Autorité de la
concurrence sollicite les observations des acteurs concernés.

[ En savoir plus ][79]
[
[logo 15 ans sans RS]
][80]

## Les 15 ans de l'Autorité de la concurrence

L’Autorité fêtait ses 15 ans le 5 novembre 2024, dans le cadre d’un événement placé sous le haut
patronage du Président de la République.

[
[eco]
][81]

## Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN)

Créé en mai 2004, le Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN) fête cette année son 20ème anniversaire.
Entre mai 2004 et décembre 2023, les autorités nationales de concurrence ont rendu plus de 1 700
décisions fondées sur l'article 101 et/ou l'article 102. Les autorités nationales de concurrence ont
lancé en moyenne 140 enquêtes et adopté 75 décisions chaque année.

[
[podcast ]
][82]

## Cartels & Cie

Cartels & Cie est un podcast dédié aux grandes affaires démantelées par l'Autorité, qui se propose
d'emmener l'auditeur dans les coulisses de ses enquêtes, au cœur de scandales économiques impliquant
des entreprises mondiales.

[
[Guide PME]
][83]

## Espace PME

Dans une démarche de pédagogie, l’Autorité a créé un espace en ligne, intégralement dédié aux PME.
Un guide est mis à leur disposition afin qu'elles connaissent mieux les règles et puissent faire
valoir leurs droits.

## Contact

Des questions sur vos démarches, des procédures en cours... Contactez-nous !

[Poser une question][84]

## Newsletter

Restez informé de l'actualité de l'Autorité de la concurrence

  collections on a daily basis, the collections serve as an ideal tool to keep researchers updated
  with new developments in the respective fields.

# **Our Strategy**

We are undertaking a strategic transformation of CNS Pharmaceuticals by executing a disciplined path
forward focused on building a high-value pipeline in neurology and oncology. These therapeutic areas
represent some of the most dynamic sectors in biopharma, where scientific innovation, regulatory
momentum and strategic investment continue to accelerate. Leveraging the deep experience of our
leadership team, we are actively pursuing and developing differentiated therapeutic opportunities
with the potential to address significant unmet medical needs and create long-term value.

[Who We Are][140]

# Our Focus

With a clearly defined strategy, we are actively pursuing the acquisition or in-licensing of
preclinical and clinical-stage assets in neurology and oncology. We prioritize programs with strong
biological rationale, differentiated mechanisms of action, well defined development and regulatory
pathways and the potential to deliver meaningful clinical impact and long-term commercial value.

[Learn More][141]

# Our Approach

We apply a disciplined, data-driven framework to identify and evaluate potential therapeutic
opportunities worldwide. Each opportunity undergoes rigorous scientific, clinical, regulatory and
commercial evaluation to identify and prioritize programs with clear differentiation and the
potential to deliver meaningful impact for patients and long-term value for stakeholders.

[Learn More][142]

# Latest News

[See All News Releases][143]

# Investor Relations

Explore our recent and upcoming events, financial results and market performance. Get a clear
picture of our strategic outlook.

[Learn More][144]

# Email Alerts

Get timely updates on our latest developments. Subscribe to email alerts for new press releases,
events and filings.

[Learn More][145]

# **Our Strategy**

We are undertaking a strategic transformation of CNS Pharmaceuticals by executing a disciplined path
forward focused on building a high-value pipeline in neurology and oncology. These therapeutic areas
represent some of the most dynamic sectors in biopharma, where scientific innovation, regulatory
momentum and strategic investment continue to accelerate. Leveraging the deep experience of our
leadership team, we are actively pursuing and developing differentiated therapeutic opportunities
with the potential to address significant unmet medical needs and create long-term value.

[Who We Are][140]

# Our Focus

With a clearly defined strategy, we are actively pursuing the acquisition or in-licensing of
preclinical and clinical-stage assets in neurology and oncology. We prioritize programs with strong
biological rationale, differentiated mechanisms of action, well defined development and regulatory
pathways and the potential to deliver meaningful clinical impact and long-term commercial value.

[Learn More][141]

# Our Approach

We apply a disciplined, data-driven framework to identify and evaluate potential therapeutic
opportunities worldwide. Each opportunity undergoes rigorous scientific, clinical, regulatory and
commercial evaluation to identify and prioritize programs with clear differentiation and the
potential to deliver meaningful impact for patients and long-term value for stakeholders.

# Help create a future without brain cancer.

### Your donation helps drive research towards better treatments and supports people affected by
### brain cancer.

[ Donate Now ][160]

# Facing a brain cancer diagnosis? You don't have to do this alone.

### Find trusted information and practical support to help at every stage of your journey.

[ Get Support ][161]

# Join Team Cure Brain Cancer Foundation at City2Surf.

### Run or walk with us to help fund life-changing brain cancer research.

[ Register Now ][162]

## I have brain cancer

Whether you’re newly diagnosed or further along in your journey, our resources are here to support
you. Learn more about your options and how to manage life with brain cancer.

## [How your support helps][184]

Our vision is to ensure that surviving brain cancer becomes the expectation, not the exception.

[ Learn More About Our Mission ][185]

## [What you've helped to achieve][186]

Thanks to people like you, we’ve invested over $31million into brain cancer research.

[ Learn More About Our Impact ][187]

## [Brain cancer is deadly.
## Survival rates are low.][188]

Unlike other cancers where survival rates have significantly improved, brain cancer has been left
behind. Over the past 40 years, the five-year survival rate has increased only marginally—from 20%
to 24%. By contrast, breast cancer survival rose from 63% to 93%.

**We are determined to change that trajectory.**

## Fundraise for us

Turn your passion into impact. Whether it’s a fun run, a community event, or a personal challenge,
fundraising is one of the most powerful ways you can support people impacted by brain cancer. Every
dollar you raise helps fund vital research, advocacy and support services.

## Volunteer with us

Your time and energy can make a real difference. From helping at Walk4BrainCancer events to lending
a hand in the office, volunteers are at the heart of what we do. Join our community of supporters
and be part of creating change for people living with brain cancer.

## Partner with us

Collaboration drives progress. By partnering with us, your organisation can help accelerate
research, improve care, and give hope to thousands of families. Together, we can build meaningful
change and demonstrate your commitment to a cause that touches many lives.

# Targeting the Source of Brain Cancer

Curtana Pharmaceuticals is advancing a novel, dual-action therapy designed to halt recurrence by
eradicating cancer stem cells and reversing tumor-driven immune suppression in adult and pediatric
brain cancers.

[Explore the Science ][10][Clinical Trials ][11]

## A Clinical-Stage Innovator in Neuro-Oncology 

At Curtana Pharmaceuticals, we are driven by an urgent mission to develop life-changing therapies
for patients facing the most devastating central nervous system (CNS) malignancies. Standard
treatments often leave behind resilient cancer stem cells – the true source of disease recurrence.
Our lead investigational therapy, CT-179, is a potent, orally available, CNS-penetrant
small-molecule inhibitor targeting OLIG2 (pronounced *OH-lig-two*), a master transcription factor
that is at the source of many types of brain cancer. By dismantling tumor architecture at its source
and reawakening the body’s innate defenses, we are committed to changing the treatment paradigm. 

## Taking Aim at Glioblastoma
* Adult Program
  
  ### Recurrent Glioblastoma (GBM)
  
  Safety, Tolerability, and MTD
  
  PreclinicalIND-EnablingPhase 1 ReadyPhase 1Phase 2
  Phase 1
  Details
  
  When GBM inevitably returns following frontline standard-of-care, the disease is exceptionally
  aggressive and highly resistant to further conventional treatments. In this recurrent setting,
  clinical options are severely limited, and median survival drops drastically to approximately 6 to
  9 months. This devastating cycle of relapse is driven by a highly resilient subpopulation of
  cancer stem cells (CSCs) that survive initial surgical and chemoradiation interventions. These
  residual CSCs rely heavily on the OLIG2 transcription factor to rebuild the tumor architecture and
  actively suppress the immune microenvironment. Because addressing this resistance is our most
  immediate clinical priority, Recurrent GBM is the foundational indication for the dose-escalation
  phase of our ongoing OPAL Trial. By utilizing CT-179 to precisely target OLIG2, we aim to
  dismantle the cellular engine of recurrence, reverse tumor-driven immune evasion, and offer a
  powerful new therapeutic avenue for patients who have exhausted standard therapies.
* Adult Program
  
  ### Newly Diagnosed MGMT-Unmethylated GBM
  
  Combo with Radiation Therapy
  
  PreclinicalIND-EnablingPhase 1 ReadyPhase 1Phase 2
  Phase 1 Ready
  Details
  
  The most common and lethal primary adult brain tumor. There are approximately 30,000 to 40,000 new
  cases diagnosed annually across major global markets. Despite maximum surgical resection,
  radiation, and chemotherapy, recurrence is nearly universal. The median overall survival is
  approximately 14 to 16 months, with a 5-year survival rate of less than 10%. Furthermore, a
  significant portion of GBM patients have an MGMT-unmethylated status, rendering their tumors
  inherently resistant to standard chemotherapy. By targeting OLIG2, we aim to eliminate the cancer
  stem cells driving recurrence and sensitize tumors to radiation and immune attack.

# Where successful fundraisers start

[Start a GoFundMe][27]
[A person cuddling their dog, shown as part of a photo collage]
No fee to start fundraising

## More than $50 million is raised every week on GoFundMe.*

Get started in just a few minutes — with helpful new tools, it’s easier than ever to pick the
perfect title, write a compelling story, and share it with the world.

## Fundraising on GoFundMe is easy, powerful, and trusted
1. 1
   
   ### Use our tools to create your fundraiser
   
   You’ll be guided by prompts to add fundraiser details and set your goal. Make updates anytime.
   
   Get tips for [starting your fundraiser][28].
2. 2
   
   ### Reach donors by sharing
   
   Share your fundraiser link and use the resources in your dashboard to gain momentum.
3. 3
   
   ### Securely receive funds
   
   Add your bank information, or invite your fundraiser beneficiary to add theirs, and start
   receiving funds.

## Discover fundraisers inspired by what you care about

We’ve got you covered.

## Get what you need to help your fundraiser succeed on GoFundMe

From [memorial][29] tributes and funerals to [medical][30] emergencies and [nonprofits][31].
Whenever you need help, you can ask here.

Still have questions? [Learn more about how GoFundMe works][32].

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

## Brain Tumor Treatment at Ivy

The Ivy Brain Tumor Center is a leader in brain tumor research and treatment. The Ivy Center is

### [ An early clinical trial of 5-ALA sonodynamic therapy in recurrent high-grade glioma ][80]

Last week, the Ivy Brain Tumor Center published a manuscript in Science Translational Medicine
authored by Nader Sanai, MD, Shwetal Mehta, PHD, Artak Tovmasyan, PHD, An-Chi Tien, PHD, Igor
Barani, MD, Charuta Furey, MD, and Zaman Mirzadeh, MD, in collaboration with other Ivy Center team
members. The manuscript presents results from our early phase clinical trial utilizing sonodynamic
therapy (SDT) in recurrent high-grade glioma patients. SDT pairs 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA),

### About Ivy Brain Tumor Center

The Ivy Brain Tumor Center at Barrow Neurological Institute in Phoenix, AZ, is a tertiary care and
nonprofit translational research program that employs bold, early-phase clinical trial strategies to
identify new treatments for aggressive brain tumors, including glioblastoma. Our leading experts in
neurosurgical oncology, neuro-oncology, radiation oncology, neuroradiology, neuropathology and
neuroscience nursing treat more patients annually than any other brain tumor center in the United
States. The Ivy Center’s Phase 0 clinical trials program is the largest in the world and enables
personalized care in a fraction of the time and cost associated with traditional drug development.
In addition, unlike conventional clinical trials focusing on single drugs, the Ivy Center’s
accelerated program tests therapeutic combinations matched to individual patients. We leave no stone
unturned in the pursuit of hope and healing.

### About Ivy Brain Tumor Center

The Ivy Brain Tumor Center at Barrow Neurological Institute in Phoenix, AZ, is a tertiary care and
nonprofit translational research program that employs bold, early-phase clinical trial strategies to
identify new treatments for aggressive brain tumors, including glioblastoma. Our leading experts in
neurosurgical oncology, neuro-oncology, radiation oncology, neuroradiology, neuropathology and
neuroscience nursing treat more patients annually than any other brain tumor center in the United
States. The Ivy Center’s Phase 0 clinical trials program is the largest in the world and enables
personalized care in a fraction of the time and cost associated with traditional drug development.
In addition, unlike conventional clinical trials focusing on single drugs, the Ivy Center’s
accelerated program tests therapeutic combinations matched to individual patients. We leave no stone
unturned in the pursuit of hope and healing.

## エピゲノム編集のパイオニア

私たちの体を構成する約2万種類のタンパク質は、作られるタイミング、場所、量がオーケストラのように非常
に精密に制御されています。これはエピゲノムと呼ばれる遺伝子制御システムによって担われていますが、この
システムが故障すると、不協和音のように病気を引き起こします。当社のエピゲノム編集技術、CRISPR-GNDM®は
、特定の遺伝子のエピゲノムを選択的に標的とし、制御することができます。これにより、不協和音を制御し、
病気を治療することが可能になるのです。

## 遺伝子治療

遺伝子疾患では、DNA配列にエラーや欠陥がしばしば見られ、これらの疾患を根本的に治療するには遺伝子レベ
ルでの治療が必要であると考えられています。遺伝子治療薬は、ウイルスベクターやナノ粒子などの方法を用い
て、正常な配列の遺伝子、異常な配列を修復するDNAやRNAなどを標的細胞に送り込みます。

[ 詳しくみる ][37]
1 2 3 4

## CRISPRゲノム編集

ゲノム編集は遺伝子治療の新分野の１つです。私たちのDNAをエラーのある特定箇所をピンポイントで狙って切
断したり、切断した箇所に正しい配列を持った遺伝子を挿入したりすることができるCRISPR技術の誕生によって
、これが実用化可能なレベルになったと考えられています。

[ 詳しくみる ][38]
1 2 3 4

## エピゲノム編集

エピゲノム編集とは、遺伝子の塩基配列自体を変えたり、二重鎖切断を行わずに、特定の遺伝子の発現状態を制
御する技術です。DNAやヒストンの修飾を変えることで、遺伝子がオンまたはオフに切り替わることを可能にし
ます。

[ 詳しくみる ][39]
1 2 3 4

## CRISPR-GNDM®

CRISPR-GNDM®は当社が開発したエピゲノム編集技術で、ウィルスベクターに搭載可能なサイズにコンパクト化さ
れたエピゲノム・エディター(編集システム)を、目的の細胞に効率良く送り届け、高い選択性をもって目的の遺
伝子のON/OFFを行うことで疾患を治すことを目指します。

[ 詳しくみる ][40]

# 全ての命に、光を

### エピゲノム編集のパイオニア

## エピゲノム編集のパイオニア

私たちの体を構成する約2万種類のタンパク質は、作られるタイミング、場所、量がオーケストラのように非常
に精密に制御されています。これはエピゲノムと呼ばれる遺伝子制御システムによって担われていますが、この
システムが故障すると、不協和音のように病気を引き起こします。当社のエピゲノム編集技術、CRISPR-GNDM®は
、特定の遺伝子のエピゲノムを選択的に標的とし、制御することができます。これにより、不協和音を制御し、
病気を治療することが可能になるのです。

## 遺伝子治療

遺伝子疾患では、DNA配列にエラーや欠陥がしばしば見られ、これらの疾患を根本的に治療するには遺伝子レベ
ルでの治療が必要であると考えられています。遺伝子治療薬は、ウイルスベクターやナノ粒子などの方法を用い
て、正常な配列の遺伝子、異常な配列を修復するDNAやRNAなどを標的細胞に送り込みます。

[ 詳しくみる ][37]
1 2 3 4

## CRISPRゲノム編集

ゲノム編集は遺伝子治療の新分野の１つです。私たちのDNAをエラーのある特定箇所をピンポイントで狙って切
断したり、切断した箇所に正しい配列を持った遺伝子を挿入したりすることができるCRISPR技術の誕生によって
、これが実用化可能なレベルになったと考えられています。

[ 詳しくみる ][38]
1 2 3 4

## エピゲノム編集

エピゲノム編集とは、遺伝子の塩基配列自体を変えたり、二重鎖切断を行わずに、特定の遺伝子の発現状態を制
御する技術です。DNAやヒストンの修飾を変えることで、遺伝子がオンまたはオフに切り替わることを可能にし
ます。

[ 詳しくみる ][39]
1 2 3 4

## CRISPR-GNDM®

CRISPR-GNDM®は当社が開発したエピゲノム編集技術で、ウィルスベクターに搭載可能なサイズにコンパクト化さ
れたエピゲノム・エディター(編集システム)を、目的の細胞に効率良く送り届け、高い選択性をもって目的の遺
伝子のON/OFFを行うことで疾患を治すことを目指します。

[ 詳しくみる ][40]
BUSINESS

## 自社開発モデルと協業開発モデルのハイブリッドによる開発展開

自社開発モデルは、自社でターゲットの選択を行い、開発資金を含めて自社でリスクを取り、よりスピーディー
な開発と高いリターンを目指します。一方で、協業開発モデルでは、パートナーとの間でリスク・プロフィット
のシェアを行います。これによって、自社のリソースだけではまかない切れないより多くのパイプラインを開発
することが可能になります。

## Breaking Through Barriers: NeOnc's Delivery Revolution

WHY NeOnc

NeOnc has developed a proprietary, patented platform technology designed to transport therapeutics
directly to the brain, overcoming the limitations of the Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB). Our innovative
formulations offer pharmaceutical companies a new pathway to deliver potentially more effective
treatments for Central Nervous System (CNS) diseases, expanding possibilities for patients.

[ Learn More ][32]

##### The Problem

The potential for greater success in treating devastating CNS diseases like Glioblastoma has long
been severely limited. The primary hurdle is the persistent inability to effectively and directly
deliver therapeutic agents to the brain, a challenge that has historically prevented many promising
treatments from reaching their full potential.

[ Read More ][33]

##### Our Solution

Our proprietary approaches and patented technologies are delivering new therapies for brain cancers.
We also facilitate the transport of established and new therapeutics across the blood-brain barrier,
significantly improving their efficacy for treating a wide range of brain diseases.

[ Read More ][34]

##### The Potential

By regulating tumor cell growth and providing a powerful transport mechanism for therapeutics, we
plan to equip doctors and healthcare professionals with the tools to deliver significantly better
outcomes for their patients.

[ Read More ][35]

## Our Latest Research & Study

Latest Studies

NeOnc maintains an aggressive regimen of research and study into our therapeutic delivery and
formulations. This commitment ensures our continued ability to impact the treatment of CNS-based
diseases.

## Breaking Through Barriers: NeOnc's Delivery Revolution

WHY NeOnc

NeOnc has developed a proprietary, patented platform technology designed to transport therapeutics
directly to the brain, overcoming the limitations of the Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB). Our innovative
formulations offer pharmaceutical companies a new pathway to deliver potentially more effective
treatments for Central Nervous System (CNS) diseases, expanding possibilities for patients.

[ Learn More ][32]

##### The Problem

The potential for greater success in treating devastating CNS diseases like Glioblastoma has long
been severely limited. The primary hurdle is the persistent inability to effectively and directly
deliver therapeutic agents to the brain, a challenge that has historically prevented many promising
treatments from reaching their full potential.

[ Read More ][33]

##### Our Solution

Our proprietary approaches and patented technologies are delivering new therapies for brain cancers.
We also facilitate the transport of established and new therapeutics across the blood-brain barrier,
significantly improving their efficacy for treating a wide range of brain diseases.

[ Read More ][34]

##### The Potential

By regulating tumor cell growth and providing a powerful transport mechanism for therapeutics, we
plan to equip doctors and healthcare professionals with the tools to deliver significantly better
outcomes for their patients.

[ Read More ][35]

treatment doesn’t mean you can’t take a vacation. Watch the [Cancer Goes to the Beach][101] webinar

and Europe.

An AI-powered PACS solution that automates manual steps across imaging, reporting, and data flow,
improving turnaround time with fewer errors.

review them in the viewer, generate AI-assisted reports, and send them directly to your EHR without
leaving the solution. Workflow automation reduces the need for manual handoffs, keeping imaging and
reporting connected from start to finish.

Our HIPAA-compliant PACS medical imaging software is a plug-and-play solution, so there’s no setup
complexity to manage. It’s platform-agnostic and comes with built-in Epic integration, fitting

Our PACS medical imaging software removes the need to piece together multiple systems, unifying
every step into one solution so everything works together in one place.

**Download Our Brochure**

### Cloud Storage

Encrypted DICOM storage supporting high-volume imaging data, with plug-and-play deployment and
access across devices and environments.

### Patient Data Management 

Access and organize patient imaging data within one system, keeping records structured, searchable,
and available when needed across clinical workflows.

### Embedded DICOM Viewer

Open, annotate, and analyze multimodal medical images like CT, MRI, X-ray, ECG, and other
specialized imaging directly in our PACS solution. 

### Smart Notifications and Audit Trail

Receive alerts for important updates and maintain a complete record of system activity in our PACS
imaging software when you need to review actions or track changes.

Our diagnostic medical imaging solution generates clinically validated reports within the system,
helping reduce reporting time while keeping outputs consistent across different users and cases.

### Role-Based Access Control

Set access levels for clinicians, radiologists, administrators, and external users with two-factor
authentication, so that anyone only sees what is relevant to their role.

### Bulk Scan Upload and Instant Sharing

Upload multiple scan sets in one go into our medical imaging software and share DICOM images
securely without delays in real time with physicians, patients, or external providers.

### Data Security 

Our PACS solution is HIPAA-compliant and offers data protection with encryption, audit trails, and
controlled access across all users.

# Lighting the Way in CNS Cancer Treatment with AI-Powered Innovation

## Born from Billions of Data points Using AI and in Collaboration with World-Leading Cancer
## Researchers

## Our Story

“Born from billions of data points using AI and in collaboration with world-class cancer
researchers”
Starlight Therapeutic is a precision oncology company focused solely on CNS (central nervous system)
cancers, primarily brain cancers, which comprise a large and growing market globally. 

It is estimated that there are over 120 subtypes of CNS cancers that have a devastating impact on
adult and pediatric populations. Most of these CNS cancers do not have effective therapies and
current treatment relies on a combination of surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy. There is a
significant need for new therapeutic options to improve patient outcomes. Starlight is developing
our lead drug candidate, known as STAR-001, for some of the most unaddressed brain cancers.

## Starlight’s Focus

CNS cancers are one of the leading causes of morbidity affecting adults, children, and the elderly
with characteristically high mortality and disability rates.

### Glioblastoma

Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most common malignant primary brain tumor accounting for approximately 50%
cases of all gliomas...

### Brain metastases

Brain metastases occur when cancer spreads from its primary site of origin to the brain. Brain
metastases is the most common type of brain cancer...

### Pediatric CNS cancers

The American Cancer Society estimates that more than 4,000 CNS tumors are diagnosed each year in
children and adolescents making primary CNS tumors...

## Born from Billions of Data points Using AI and in Collaboration with World-Leading Cancer
## Researchers

## Our Story

“Born from billions of data points using AI and in collaboration with world-class cancer
researchers”
Starlight Therapeutic is a precision oncology company focused solely on CNS (central nervous system)
cancers, primarily brain cancers, which comprise a large and growing market globally. 

It is estimated that there are over 120 subtypes of CNS cancers that have a devastating impact on
adult and pediatric populations. Most of these CNS cancers do not have effective therapies and
current treatment relies on a combination of surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy. There is a
significant need for new therapeutic options to improve patient outcomes. Starlight is developing
our lead drug candidate, known as STAR-001, for some of the most unaddressed brain cancers.

## Starlight’s Focus

CNS cancers are one of the leading causes of morbidity affecting adults, children, and the elderly
with characteristically high mortality and disability rates.

### Glioblastoma

Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most common malignant primary brain tumor accounting for approximately 50%
cases of all gliomas...

### Brain metastases

Brain metastases occur when cancer spreads from its primary site of origin to the brain. Brain
metastases is the most common type of brain cancer...

### Pediatric CNS cancers

The American Cancer Society estimates that more than 4,000 CNS tumors are diagnosed each year in
children and adolescents making primary CNS tumors...

## Что такое скрипт на Укради Брейнрот

Скрипт на Укради Брейнрот — это Lua-код, который запускается через экзекутор (executor, он же
инжектор) и добавляет в игру функции, которых нет по умолчанию: авто-кражу брейнрота (**Авто Стил /
Auto Steal**, Инстант Стил / Instant Steal), **ЕСП (ESP)** и **Аимбот (Aimbot)**, **Авто Фарм (Auto
Farm)**, **Год Мод (God Mode)** и победу в дуэлях. По сути это чит на Укради Брейнрот, который
экономит часы гринда. Скрипт и чит — это одно и то же, поэтому «скачать чит на укради брейнрот» и
«скачать скрипт» ведут к одному бесплатному коду из нашего каталога.

Steal a Brainrot в русском Роблокс (Roblox) называется **«Укради Брейнрот»** (или «Украдите
Брейнрот»), сокращённо **SAB** / «саб». Игроки часто пишут название по-разному — «укради браинрот»,
«укради бренрот», «укради брейн рот», «укради брэйнрот» — это всё одна и та же игра и один и тот же
скрипт. Мы используем оба названия, чтобы ты нашёл нужный скрипт как ни ищи.

Скрипт не нужно устанавливать как программу. Ты скачиваешь .lua файл, открываешь его в экзекуторе —
**Дельта (Delta)**, **Ксено (Xeno)**, **Solara** — и жмёшь Execute. Всё, скрипт запущен, открывается
меню с функциями. Никакой установки, никакого риска для файлов на ПК.

## Что такое скрипт на Укради Брейнрот

Скрипт на Укради Брейнрот — это Lua-код, который запускается через экзекутор (executor, он же
инжектор) и добавляет в игру функции, которых нет по умолчанию: авто-кражу брейнрота (**Авто Стил /
Auto Steal**, Инстант Стил / Instant Steal), **ЕСП (ESP)** и **Аимбот (Aimbot)**, **Авто Фарм (Auto
Farm)**, **Год Мод (God Mode)** и победу в дуэлях. По сути это чит на Укради Брейнрот, который
экономит часы гринда. Скрипт и чит — это одно и то же, поэтому «скачать чит на укради брейнрот» и
«скачать скрипт» ведут к одному бесплатному коду из нашего каталога.

Steal a Brainrot в русском Роблокс (Roblox) называется **«Укради Брейнрот»** (или «Украдите
Брейнрот»), сокращённо **SAB** / «саб». Игроки часто пишут название по-разному — «укради браинрот»,
«укради бренрот», «укради брейн рот», «укради брэйнрот» — это всё одна и та же игра и один и тот же
скрипт. Мы используем оба названия, чтобы ты нашёл нужный скрипт как ни ищи.

Скрипт не нужно устанавливать как программу. Ты скачиваешь .lua файл, открываешь его в экзекуторе —
**Дельта (Delta)**, **Ксено (Xeno)**, **Solara** — и жмёшь Execute. Всё, скрипт запущен, открывается
меню с функциями. Никакой установки, никакого риска для файлов на ПК.

## Как устроена игра Укради Брейнрот

Чтобы понять, зачем нужны скрипты, разберёмся с механикой. В Укради Брейнрот у каждого игрока есть
**база** с ячейками (слотами). По **конвейеру (conveyor)** едут брейнроты разной редкости — их можно
купить за деньги и поставить на базу. Каждый брейнрот на базе **пассивно приносит деньги в секунду
($/сек)** в зависимости от редкости: чем реже персонаж, тем больше доход.

# Overcoming Resistance in
# Malignant Brain Cancer

## First-in-class inhibitor of calcium signaling targeting glioblastoma and resistant solid tumors

Tactical Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative therapies
designed to penetrate the brain and overcome resistance in the most aggressive cancers.

Newly Diagnosed GBM
0 %
Two-Year Survival Rate
0 %
Best-in-Class Therapy
0

#### One Step Ahead

## Advancing Breakthrough Therapies for the Most Challenging Cancers

Tactical Therapeutics is focused on the development of a patented therapeutic platform targeting
glioblastoma (GBM) and other resistant solid tumors. The company’s lead compound,
Carboxyamidotriazole Orotate (CTO), is an oral, brain-penetrant therapy designed to inhibit calcium
signaling pathways associated with multiple oncogenic mechanisms.

Our mission is to overcome therapeutic resistance in cancers where current treatments fall short,
bringing new hope to patients facing devastating diagnoses.

#### Tactical Therapeutics

## A Novel Approach to Targeting Cancer Resistance

Our lead therapeutic, CTO, is a first-in-class and best-in-class inhibitor of non-voltage-dependent
calcium (ca)²⁺ signaling, impacting multiple oncogenic pathways simultaneously.

### Oral therapy with strong safety profile

### Crosses the blood-brain barrier effectively

### Targets multiple cancer pathways

### Designed to overcome resistance mechanisms

#### Tactical Therapeutics

## Meet The Founder, CEO, Board Member & President

### Rashida A. Karmali, Ph. D, JD, MBA

Founder, CEO, Board Member & President
[ Learn More ][23]

#### three steps to success

## Promising Clinical Outcomes in Difficult-to-Treat Patients

Clinical trials of CTO have demonstrated encouraging results in patients with advanced and recurrent
glioblastoma:

### Complete and partial responses observed in heavily pretreated patients

### 69% two-year survival rate

### 93% one-year survival rate

### Long-term recurrence-free survivors reported

## Building the Future of Oncology Therapeutics

Tactical Therapeutics is advancing its clinical program through early-phase trials and preparing for
Phase II development in glioblastoma and other solid tumors.

### Early-phase oncology trial execution

### Pharmacokinetics and tissue penetration studies

### Biomarker-driven translational research

### Imaging-based response assessment

### Preclinical and clinical integration strategies

#### Partner With Us

## Partnering to Transform Cancer Treatment

Tactical Therapeutics is actively seeking strategic partners to advance development and
commercialization of CTO and related therapies.

We collaborate with leading researchers, clinicians, and organizations committed to improving
outcomes for patients with glioblastoma and resistant cancers.

## Driving innovation where it matters most—at the frontlines of cancer resistance.

[ Learn More About Us ][24]
Tactical Therapeutics is dedicated to developing breakthrough therapies for patients facing the most
aggressive and treatment-resistant cancers. Our mission is to overcome the biological barriers that
limit current therapies and deliver meaningful, lasting outcomes where few options exist.

# Malignant Brain Cancer

## First-in-class inhibitor of calcium signaling targeting glioblastoma and resistant solid tumors

Tactical Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative therapies
designed to penetrate the brain and overcome resistance in the most aggressive cancers.

#### One Step Ahead

## Advancing Breakthrough Therapies for the Most Challenging Cancers

Tactical Therapeutics is focused on the development of a patented therapeutic platform targeting
glioblastoma (GBM) and other resistant solid tumors. The company’s lead compound,
Carboxyamidotriazole Orotate (CTO), is an oral, brain-penetrant therapy designed to inhibit calcium
signaling pathways associated with multiple oncogenic mechanisms.

Our mission is to overcome therapeutic resistance in cancers where current treatments fall short,
bringing new hope to patients facing devastating diagnoses.

#### Tactical Therapeutics

## A Novel Approach to Targeting Cancer Resistance

Our lead therapeutic, CTO, is a first-in-class and best-in-class inhibitor of non-voltage-dependent
calcium (ca)²⁺ signaling, impacting multiple oncogenic pathways simultaneously.

### Oral therapy with strong safety profile

### Crosses the blood-brain barrier effectively

### Targets multiple cancer pathways

### Designed to overcome resistance mechanisms

#### Tactical Therapeutics

glioblastoma:

### 93% one-year survival rate

## Building the Future of Oncology Therapeutics

Tactical Therapeutics is advancing its clinical program through early-phase trials and preparing for
Phase II development in glioblastoma and other solid tumors.

### Early-phase oncology trial execution

We collaborate with leading researchers, clinicians, and organizations committed to improving
outcomes for patients with glioblastoma and resistant cancers.

# Innovative Treatment for Brain Cancer

We are working to advance GB-13 to clinical trials where new therapies are in desperate need
including glioblastoma, diffuse midline glioma, and soft tissue sarcomas.

[ Learn More ][9]
[Asset 2]

**Glioblastoma (GBM) in adults and Diffuse Midline Glioma (DMG) in children are uniformly fatal. We
are developing a desperately needed novel biologic therapy.**

The median survival rate for GBM and DMG is only 14 months and has remained largely unchanged for
decades, and no new treatments have been approved for these cancers in over 20 years.

Targepeutics has now obtained orphan drug designation for GB-13 from the Food and Drug
Administration (FDA), opening paths to needed resources. GB-13 specifically targets a
cancer-specific receptor and drives cancer cell death and can be incorporated into current treatment
regimens.

[Targepeutics Homepage Icon_01]

### Drug
### Discovery

We recognized the need to specifically target the cancer associated IL13Rα2 receptor ONLY.

[Targepeutics Homepage Icon_02]

### Research & Development

We leverage that platform to develop drugs that are highly selective, very safe and, most
importantly, WORK.

[Targepeutics Homepage Icon_03]

### Clinical
### Design

We are taking our first drug, GB-13 to the clinic to deliver RESULTS to patients and their families.

[ Learn More ][10]

## A personal message from our CEO

In 1999, when my mother was diagnosed with a GBM, I would talk to anybody and everybody who would
listen to me about brain cancer. Many people were very kind to spend time with her, myself and my
family to help navigate the many difficult decisions during her illness. I was and am eternally
thankful for the kindness of so many.

I was also frustrated that there was a lack of viable treatment options that would give her a
fighting chance. Over 20 years later, I look at the current treatment options for GBM patients. We
know we can do better for these patients and their families.  GB-13 belongs in the paradigm of care
for Glioblastoma and diffuse midline glioma patients.  We won’t stop until GB-13 is in the clinic.

[Walene Lutkewitte]

## Get in touch

Contact us to learn more about our progress as we seek to take GB13 to clinical trials.

## The Spark of Innovation

Our mission of discovery and healing comes alive every day in the research labs, classrooms, and
clinical spaces all across our campus in Dallas-Fort Worth. That’s where some of the brightest minds
in science and medicine are following their spark and connecting the dots between bold ideas and
tangible, lifesaving treatments for our patients.

[Learn More][88]

**Patient Notification**

UT Southwestern Medical Center is notifying affected patients of a privacy incident involving
patient information in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
(HIPAA), as some individuals could not be reached by mail.

On Jan. 14, 2026, UT Southwestern became aware of a privacy incident involving the Care Everywhere
health information exchange (HIE). In December 2025, vendors SelfRx, Ravilla, GuardDog, and Mammoth
accessed patient information beyond their authorized scope without a valid treatment, payment, or
healthcare operations purpose. The information varied by individual and may have included name,
address, date of birth, medication information, and treatment history. It did not include credit
card numbers or other financial account information. At this time, there is no evidence the
information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

UTSW took immediate steps to terminate unauthorized access, secure affected systems, identify and
notify impacted individuals, and implement additional safeguards, including enhanced access
controls, monitoring, and oversight of HIE activity. No action is required at this time. As a
precaution, we encourage you to review healthcare statements and communications and report any
concerns. Imp

## The Spark of Innovation

Our mission of discovery and healing comes alive every day in the research labs, classrooms, and
clinical spaces all across our campus in Dallas-Fort Worth. That’s where some of the brightest minds
in science and medicine are following their spark and connecting the dots between bold ideas and
tangible, lifesaving treatments for our patients.

[Learn More][88]

**Patient Notification**

UT Southwestern Medical Center is notifying affected patients of a privacy incident involving
patient information in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
(HIPAA), as some individuals could not be reached by mail.

On Jan. 14, 2026, UT Southwestern became aware of a privacy incident involving the Care Everywhere
health information exchange (HIE). In December 2025, vendors SelfRx, Ravilla, GuardDog, and Mammoth
accessed patient information beyond their authorized scope without a valid treatment, payment, or
healthcare operations purpose. The information varied by individual and may have included name,
address, date of birth, medication information, and treatment history. It did not include credit
card numbers or other financial account information. At this time, there is no evidence the
information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

UTSW took immediate steps to terminate unauthorized access, secure affected systems, identify and
notify impacted individuals, and implement additional safeguards, including enhanced access
controls, monitoring, and oversight of HIE activity. No action is required at this time. As a
precaution, we encourage you to review healthcare statements and communications and report any
concerns. Impacted individuals can contact our dedicated call center at [833-445-1229][89]. We
deeply regret the occurrence of this incident and any worry, distress, or difficulty that it may
cause. We appreciate the trust you place in UT Southwestern for your healthcare.

## Specialty Highlights

We bring world-class care to you, delivered with expertise and compassion. Learn more about our
leading-edge therapies, innovative treatments, and exceptional specialty care.

* [ [O'Donnell Brain Institute] O'Donnell Brain Institute ][92]

* [ [Spine Center] Spine Center ][94]
* [ [Transplant] Transplant ][95]

## UTSWMyCare App

UT Southwestern’s patient care app – UTSWMyCare – helps you easily manage your health and stay
connected to UTSW and your provider. Find a physician. Access your medical records. Schedule
appointments, and much more.

UTSWMyCare is simple to use, convenient, and always available. It’s medicine made easier.

[Learn More][96]

[Clements University Hospital image]

Our Hospital & Clinics

With our University Hospital, over 40 locations, and several hundred clinics, at UT Southwestern you
can find experienced doctors and specialists to provide the care that you need close to home.

[Find a Location][97]

## Virtual Visits with your Doctor

A Video Visit is a safe and convenient way to get access to a broad spectrum of primary and
specialty services at UT Southwestern while still receiving the same high-quality care you would
receive in person—saving you time and travel.

[Get Started with Your Virtual Visit][98]
